summary: Implemented file-read progress tracking in rich/progress.py: a private _Reader wrapper class (read/read1/readline/readinto/iteration/seek/close, delegating other attributes to the wrapped handle), Progress.read(file, total=None, description) for paths or file-like objects (total required for file-like objects), and a module-level rich.progress.read helper that creates and starts its own Progress. Added a CHANGELOG.md entry under Unreleased. Nothing was run, per instructions; no tests were added, and black/mypy/pytest were not executed. Nothing was committed.
